description_ru: Девушка осматривает квартиру с агентом по недвижимости и задаёт вопросы.
text:
Agent: Come in, Emma. This is the living room. As you can see, it gets a lot of light in the afternoon.
Emma: It's really bright. Has the flat been empty for long?
Agent: No, the last tenants moved out two weeks ago. They have just painted the walls.
Emma: I can smell the paint. Could we open a window?
Agent: Of course. Now, the kitchen is through here. The fridge and the cooker are included.
Emma: That's a good thing, because I don't have any furniture yet. How much is the rent?
Agent: It is seven hundred pounds a month, and you also pay for electricity and water.
Emma: Hmm, that's a little more than I wanted to spend. If you could lower the price, I would take it today.
Agent: I'm afraid I can't change the rent, but the owner might give you a discount if you sign a two-year contract.
Emma: Two years is a long time. What happens if I need to leave earlier?
Agent: You would have to give three months' notice. It's quite normal.
Emma: And what are the neighbours like?
Agent: Very quiet. The woman next door is a retired teacher, and she has lived here for thirty years.
Emma: That sounds wonderful. Can I think about it until tomorrow?
Agent: Certainly. Here is my card. Please call me whenever you are ready.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка поднят к нёбу, но не касается его и не вибрирует; губы слегка округлены. Это не русское «р».
Кончик языка слегка просуньте между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «ф».
Откройте рот шире, чем для русского «э», язык низко и впереди: звук между «э» и «а».

questions.question: When did the last tenants leave?
